content.comment_body: Hello, Is there information about when an update will be available for Mac Monterey compatibility? Best regards, [user_name] --------------------------------------------- Split from issue: unable to open the setup application on Mac.

analysis.insight_summary: A user is requesting details about the timeline for an update that will allow a [company_name] product to work with MacOS Monterey. Currently, the lack of support for the latest MacOS version is hindering installation and regular usage.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects [company_name] to release an update that supports MacOS Monterey and to clearly communicate planned release schedules.
